goal.en: Regions and AZs, shared responsibility, Well-Architected, and the scaling and coupling ideas every design question builds on.
goal.pt-br: Regiões e AZs, responsabilidade compartilhada, Well-Architected e as ideias de escala e acoplamento que todas as questões de design usam.

goal.en: IAM users, roles and policies, federation, and how Organizations, SCPs and Control Tower secure many accounts.
goal.pt-br: Usuários, roles e políticas do IAM, federação, e como Organizations, SCPs e Control Tower protegem várias contas.

goal.en: Subnets, routing, NAT, security groups, endpoints, and connecting VPCs and data centers with peering, Transit Gateway, VPN and Direct Connect.
goal.pt-br: Sub-redes, rotas, NAT, security groups, endpoints, e como ligar VPCs e data centers com peering, Transit Gateway, VPN e Direct Connect.

goal.en: CloudFront, Global Accelerator, TLS certificates, and WAF and Shield against web attacks and DDoS.
goal.pt-br: CloudFront, Global Accelerator, certificados TLS, e WAF e Shield contra ataques web e DDoS.

goal.en: EC2 types, purchasing and placement, Auto Scaling, load balancers, and hybrid and edge compute.
goal.pt-br: Tipos de EC2, compra e posicionamento, Auto Scaling, load balancers, e computação híbrida e de borda.

goal.en: ECS, EKS and Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway and Step Functions, and when each fits.
goal.pt-br: ECS, EKS e Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway e Step Functions, e quando usar cada um.

goal.en: S3 classes, performance and lifecycle, EBS volume types, EFS and FSx file systems, and hybrid storage.
goal.pt-br: Classes, desempenho e ciclo de vida do S3, tipos de volume EBS, sistemas de arquivos EFS e FSx, e armazenamento híbrido.

goal.en: RDS and Aurora replicas, failover and encryption, DynamoDB capacity and global tables, purpose-built databases and ElastiCache.
goal.pt-br: Réplicas, failover e criptografia no RDS e no Aurora, capacidade e global tables no DynamoDB, bancos especializados e ElastiCache.

goal.en: SQS, SNS, EventBridge and Amazon MQ, and the patterns that keep tiers independent.
goal.pt-br: SQS, SNS, EventBridge e Amazon MQ, e os padrões que mantêm as camadas independentes.

goal.en: Kinesis and MSK for streams, Glue, Athena and Lake Formation for data lakes, plus EMR, Redshift and dashboards.
goal.pt-br: Kinesis e MSK para streams, Glue, Athena e Lake Formation para data lakes, além de EMR, Redshift e dashboards.

goal.en: Choosing between DataSync, Snow Family, Transfer Family, Storage Gateway and DMS to move data and applications.
goal.pt-br: Escolher entre DataSync, Snow Family, Transfer Family, Storage Gateway e DMS para mover dados e aplicações.

goal.en: RTO and RPO, the four DR strategies, AWS Backup and Elastic Disaster Recovery.
goal.pt-br: RTO e RPO, as quatro estratégias de DR, AWS Backup e Elastic Disaster Recovery.

goal.en: KMS, CloudHSM and secrets, and the detection and compliance services: GuardDuty, Macie, Inspector, Security Hub, Config and CloudTrail.
goal.pt-br: KMS, CloudHSM e secrets, e os serviços de detecção e conformidade: GuardDuty, Macie, Inspector, Security Hub, Config e CloudTrail.

goal.en: CloudWatch, X-Ray and managed Prometheus and Grafana, plus CloudFormation, immutable deployments and service quotas.
goal.pt-br: CloudWatch, X-Ray e Prometheus e Grafana gerenciados, além de CloudFormation, deploys imutáveis e cotas de serviço.

goal.en: The managed services for text, speech, images and documents, and SageMaker AI.
goal.pt-br: Os serviços gerenciados para texto, fala, imagens e documentos, e o SageMaker AI.

goal.en: Cost Explorer, Budgets, anomaly detection, data transfer costs and Savings Plans.
goal.pt-br: Cost Explorer, Budgets, detecção de anomalias, custos de transferência de dados e Savings Plans.

goal.en: Complete designs that combine the services above, as scenario questions describe them.
goal.pt-br: Arquiteturas completas que combinam os serviços acima, como as questões de cenário descrevem.
